SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.MEMNUM) FROM VOUCHER_LOG v WHERE v.ENDDATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) ) AS activeMembers,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER m WHERE m.memCreated >= TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM') AND m.memCreated < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),1) ) AS monthNewMembers,
( NVL( (SELECT SUM(s.ACTUALAMOUNT) FROM SALES_SERVICE s WHERE s.CREATEDAT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM') AND s.CREATEDAT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),1) ), 0) + NVL( (SELECT SUM(i.TOTALAMOUNT) FROM SALES_ITEM i WHERE i.CREATEDAT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM') AND i.CREATEDAT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),1) ), 0) ) AS mtdRevenue FROM dual
